The index costs about a second to build, so it is built on a worker the first time the field is typed in (:class:`_IndexLoader`), and the field says so until it lands. records.translation: 本模块在 GUI 线程上所做的任何事情都不会阻塞它。构建索引大约需要一秒钟，因此它会在首次向搜索框输入时在工作线程上构建（:class:`_IndexLoader`），在构建完成之前，搜索框会显示相应提示。文档网站是否有响应是一个网络问题，因此同样在工作线程上询问（:class:`_DocsReach`），而且只会在用户打开 API 结果时才询问——spaCR 不会因为有人输入了内容就访问网络。

records.source: THE VIEW IS PART OF THE GATE. An outline on the screen means nothing without the camera it was drawn through, so the gate carries the camera as ``projection``: a 4 x 4 matrix taking a measurement ``(x, y, z, 1)`` to homogeneous view coordinates ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, scaled so that ``sw`` is positive in front of the camera. records.context: The view is part of the data-selection boundary. The outline lives in ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. Rows one, two and four are the whole of what :meth:`mask` needs, so re-applying a saved data-selection boundary needs no plotting library and gives the same answer on any machine; the depth row only lets the outline be drawn back into the volume from another angle.
records.translation: “视图是门控的一部分。”屏幕上的轮廓如果没有绘制时所用的相机就毫无意义，因此门控以 ``projection`` 的形式携带相机：一个 4 x 4 矩阵，将测量值 ``(x, y, z, 1)`` 映射到齐次视图坐标 ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``，并经过缩放使 ``sw`` 在相机前方为正。轮廓位于 ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)`` 中。第一、二、四行就是 :meth:`mask` 所需的全部内容，因此重新应用已保存的门控不需要任何绘图库，并且在任何机器上都得到相同的结果；深度行只是让轮廓可以从另一个角度重新绘制回体数据中。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.NewsPanel#2
records.source: AND THEN IT CATCHES UP. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it, and that is what went wrong: "im on 1.5.1.0 and the news only goes to 1.5.0.7. the news section should always automatically reflect the latest spacr release news." So after the page is shown, :attr:`refresh_requested` asks the window to read the public releases list on a worker thread, and :meth:`apply_releases` merges whatever comes back in front of the bundled list. Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.
records.context: And then it catches up. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it, and that is what went wrong: "im on 1.5.1.0 and the news only goes to 1.5.0.7. the news section should always automatically reflect the latest spacr release news." So after the page is shown, :attr:`refresh_requested` asks the window to read the public releases list on a background execution unit, and :meth:`apply_releases` merges whatever comes back in front of the bundled list. Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.
records.translation: “然后它会追上最新进度。”一个发布版本的 wheel 不可能包含其自身的发布说明——说明是在 GitHub 发布版本发布时写的，而那时该 wheel 已经在 PyPI 上了——因此内置文件总是比携带它的构建落后一个版本，问题正出在这里：“我用的是 1.5.1.0，新闻却只到 1.5.0.7。新闻栏目应当始终自动反映最新的 spacr 发布新闻。”因此，在页面显示之后，:attr:`refresh_requested` 会请求窗口在工作线程上读取公开的发布列表，:meth:`apply_releases` 会把返回的任何内容合并到内置列表之前。这里不会打开任何套接字：面板只是发出请求，而获取失败、被限流、在“首选项”中被关闭，或者只是没有找到更新的内容时，内置列表都会保持绘制时的原样。
